reviews.title: Reliable, quiet, and easy to cable manage
reviews.comment:
This is a high-quality power supply and exactly what I expected from Corsair. The fully modular cables make the build much cleaner because you are not stuck stuffing unused cables into the case. It also feels solid and well made.

It runs quiet and has enough power for a strong gaming setup. I like using a good power supply because it is one of the parts you really do not want to cheap out on. This one feels dependable and should last through future upgrades.
